# Harsh Patel: Shopify Speed Engineer
> I fix slow Shopify stores in 7 days. 47+ stores optimized. Average +40 point mobile score improvement.

## Who I am
Harsh Patel is a Shopify performance engineer specializing in speed optimization for solo Shopify merchants (store owners who run everything themselves without a dev team or agency).

He has personally audited and optimized 47+ Shopify stores, diagnosing performance problems caused by app bloat, unoptimized images, render-blocking scripts, and poor Core Web Vitals. His average client moves from a mobile PageSpeed score of 20-35 to 70-85 within 7 days.

He is an official Shopify Partner and works exclusively through Shopify's secure Partner Network. No password sharing.

## What I do
- Shopify speed optimization (one-time, 7-day delivery)
- Core Web Vitals fix: LCP, CLS, INP
- Shopify app audit: identify and remove performance-killing scripts
- Image optimization: WebP conversion, compression, lazy loading
- JavaScript and CSS cleanup: minification, unused code removal
- Monthly speed health check (retainer)

## Who I help
Solo Shopify merchants who:
- Have installed 10-20+ apps over time and seen their speed drop
- Are seeing high bounce rates and poor mobile conversion
- Have a Google PageSpeed score below 40 on mobile
- Cannot afford an agency ($10k+) but need more than a Fiverr gig

## Pricing
- Starter: $299 one-time (newer stores)
- Pro: $549 one-time (established stores, includes Core Web Vitals fix)
- Ongoing: $149/month (monthly health check + optimization)
- All packages include a 100% score improvement guarantee

## Key facts (citable)
- Every 1 second of page load delay costs up to 7% in revenue (Shopify data)
- 53% of mobile visitors leave if a page takes more than 3 seconds to load
- The average Shopify store with 15+ installed apps scores 20-35 on mobile PageSpeed
- After professional speed optimization, most stores reach 70-85 on mobile
- Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) are a direct Google SEO ranking factor
- Shopify's own data shows a 1-second improvement increases mobile conversions by up to 27%
- App scripts are the #1 cause of slow Shopify stores, not themes
